purpose: Freeze the next calendar-only panel and exact causal composition of account-specific scanner candidates, Micro-v0.1 plans and execution outcomes, pre-decision account state, same-account scarcity priority, deterministic research sizing, and campaign-ledger events before any retrospective review.

sampling_contract.registration_note: The final scheduled session had not completed when the calendar was frozen; this makes the panel prospective at registration rather than selected from results.
sampling_contract.scope_limit: Ten consecutive scheduled sessions are a causal integration pilot, not representative evidence of profitability or Ross-level imitation.

candidate_and_micro_contract.candidate_universe: union of every causal market candidate admitted by either frozen main or small scanner profile
candidate_and_micro_contract.account_qualification: each account retains its own frozen strategy profile and a separate candidate disposition
candidate_and_micro_contract.scarcity_rank_snapshot: the exact causal activation CandidateSnapshot; later scanner state cannot cancel, upgrade, or rerank the frozen Micro opportunity
candidate_and_micro_contract.unavailable_candidate_or_micro_input: retained explicitly with no fabricated plan or fill

sizing_contract.rule: maximum positive whole shares inside remaining buying power, starter, campaign and total notional, and campaign and total open-risk ceilings
sizing_contract.authority_limit: A modeled transaction print supports price-path research only; the resulting quantity is not a claim that displayed or hidden liquidity could fill it.

event_order: plan emissions before entry attempts at the same timestamp
exit fills after entry attempts at the same timestamp
chronology_contract.accepted_entry_exit_quantity: the accepted synthetic entry quantity, never the provider print size
chronology_contract.open_micro_outcome: remain open and explicitly unresolved; no session-close price is invented
chronology_contract.plan_local_exit_limit: stop or target exits are applied only to the accepted quantity for that exact Micro plan

workflow_sequence: capture_or supply hash-bound pre-decision account snapshots separately for main and small accounts
build union market runtime and account-specific scanner dispositions without top-N filtering
replay unchanged Micro-v0.1 and deterministic execution for every eligible activation
compose each account independently in the registered chronological event order
freeze and verify all runtime hashes before any retrospective inventory or review
evaluate acquisition setup execution and portfolio feasibility as separate descriptive gates
promotion_gate: After the ten dates and both account inputs are available, freeze a fully hash-bound label-blind runtime; only then may a separate retrospective component comparison be registered.
